ios.desc:
RetouchAI is your ultimate AI-powered photo editing app, designed to help you create and enhance images with ease. Whether you're a casual creator or a professional, RetouchAI offers cutting-edge tools to elevate your visual content. Effortlessly generate stunning images from text prompts, extend your photos with seamless outpainting, refine details with precision inpainting, and remove unwanted objects using the erase feature.

Start with 5 free credits to explore these advanced tools. When you're ready for more, you can easily purchase additional credits in-app to unlock the full potential of RetouchAI and keep creating high-quality results.

show_hn.title: Show HN: I made an iOS app to create and expand your images

quotes.text:
Hello everyone! I just launched an iOS app called RetouchAI!

You can easily type in a prompt, ask the AI to enhance it and generate a cool image you can download to your gallery.

Also you can expand the generated image (or any other from your gallery/camera) beyond the borders, making a cool “zoom-out” effect.

See examples of the quality of the images you can create visiting https://www.getretouchai.app/#gallery.

More features to come, including inpainting, erasing and upscaling.

You have 5 free credits to use the app, and there’s no need to login. Just download it and try it: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/retouchai/id6670794301
